description: Follow-up promised by the fz-mue.29 page (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.29.html), which the user approved 2026-11-20 with the recommended answer to every decision (relayed by Elixir Parity). In Elixir typespecs a map type is closed: it admits only the listed pairs (a bare key means a required pair). Start with a census of what closing map types breaks in fz today (fixtures, specs, std), then propose. Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: Map types are closed, as in Elixir typespecs
